extensions.answer: Yes. The harness FAILs a recipe whose exit is 0 when stdout bytes differ from the git blob. On the live fixture, git archive exits 0 and FAILs as wrong-bytes-eol-only; git cat-file PASSes. An exit-code-only mutant false-greens archive. A name-only mutant misses a planted non-git CRLF writer which the real harness catches. SUCCESS:TST-0252
extensions.question: Does the docs-verification harness catch a recipe that RUNS successfully but returns the wrong bytes? Concretely: `git archive | tar -x` returns CRLF worktree bytes on Windows, not the LF blob, so any recipe telling a reader to verify formatting that way is wrong. PASS requires the harness to compare each recipe's OUTPUT against the authoritative source, not just its exit code.
extensions.title: A WRONG documented recipe is caught: the git-archive CRLF trap
